ratio_conventions.stock_dividend_ratio: new shares received per pre-event share
ratio_conventions.bonus_share_ratio: new shares received per pre-event share
ratio_conventions.rights_ratio: new subscription shares available per pre-event share
ratio_conventions.split_ratio: new shares after split per share before split
ratio_conventions.reverse_split_ratio: old shares required for one new share

return_formula: total_return_t = (raw_close_t * share_multiplier + cash_dividend_per_pre_event_share - rights_ratio * rights_subscription_price) / raw_close_t_minus_1 - 1

event_formulas.CASH_DIVIDEND: share_multiplier unchanged; add cash_dividend_per_share to terminal wealth
event_formulas.RIGHTS_ISSUE: add rights_ratio shares and deduct rights_ratio multiplied by rights_subscription_price; never model as a split
event_formulas.SHARE_CONVERSION: fail closed unless the conversion ratio and security identity transition are verified
event_formulas.MERGER: fail closed unless consideration, conversion ratio and successor security identity are verified
event_formulas.OTHER: not adjustment-eligible without a separately reviewed formula

multiple_events_same_date: Aggregate cash amounts and additive share entitlements per pre-event share; multiply split terms; combine rights cash outflows. Conflicting terms block the date.
rounding: Retain full floating-point precision in return construction; board-lot and whole-share rounding are applied only in portfolio execution, not in index-style total return.
effective_date: Use the verified ex-right date, not payment date or record date.
vintage_point_in_time: An event is adjustment-eligible only when the official available_at timestamp is not later than the ex-right date. Later corrections create a new adjustment version and never rewrite an earlier artifact in place.

price_fields.source_adjusted_close: provider adjustment retained for comparison only
price_fields.research_adjusted_close: price-like cumulative index whose one-period percentage change equals verified research total return

source_priority: credentialed SSI source when legally accessible
fail_closed_conditions: material event lacks verified ex-right date
cash amount, share ratio or rights subscription price is missing
independent sources conflict beyond declared tolerance
official publication is later than the ex-right date
a source-adjusted versus raw-return change above one percentage point is unmatched
security identity or merger/conversion successor is ambiguous
